our story

A table set the Armenian way

Nairi is the ancient name poets gave to the land of Armenia — a country of orchards, stone churches and long, generous tables. We carry that spirit to Dubai: recipes passed down at home, bread baked fresh, and meat grilled slowly over real charcoal.

Step inside and you'll find hand-woven plates on the walls, warm wood, and the smell of the grill. Step outside to our cozy green terrace. Either way, you're family the moment you sit down.

Barev dzez — welcome to Nairi.

the kitchen

From the charcoal grill & the tonir

Everything is made in-house, the way it's made at home in Armenia — generous portions, fresh herbs, and nothing rushed.

from the oven

Khachapuri

Pillowy dough baked golden and layered with melting cheese — the dish every table starts with.

from the charcoal

Khorovats

Armenian barbecue — marinated skewers of lamb, beef and chicken grilled over open coals and served on fresh lavash.

signature

Lobster Lyulya

Our guests' favourite — delicate hand-minced lobster kebab, a Nairi original you won't find anywhere else in Dubai.

gatherings

Celebrate the way Armenians do

In Armenia, every good occasion ends around a long table. Bring your birthday, family gathering or company dinner to Nairi and we'll take care of the rest — the grill, the toasts, and the music.

  • Cozy indoor dining room & green outdoor terrace
  • Group menus and family-style feasts
  • Free, easy parking at Azizi Riviera
  • Breakfast through dinner, every day 10 AM – 1 AM
